repos_data.description: Free, open-source meeting notes app for Mac: records Zoom, Meet and Teams without a bot, transcribes on-device (whisper.cpp + Breeze ASR 25), identifies speakers, and writes timestamped notes with your own Claude or ChatGPT. 拾音
Free offline speech-to-text & subtitles (SRT/VTT) in 99 languages on any GPU — AMD, NVIDIA, Intel, Apple. Whisper via whisper.cpp + MCP server for Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI.
Windows-native MCP server for local audio transcription — GPU accelerated via Vulkan, works with Claude Desktop
